Description:

[left][b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b]:
Not compatible with mods that alter the quarry area of the mountains map (Mountains.xnb). I only edit the right side after the bridge to the quarry.
Compatible with mods that alter the mountains map (Mountains.xnb) if they are loaded before mine. Not vouching for the result.
Compatible with mods that alter spritesheets used by the mountains map.
 [/left][b][u]Changes[/u][/b]: (Just look at the images instead.)[list]
[*]Smoothed out and straighten grass bordering the quarry.
[*]Smoothed out dirt, removing holes, stones, patches of grass.
[*]Removed path to minecart. (You can make your own)
[*]Removed  all clutter and boulders.
[*]Moved nature to not obscure  the quarry .
[*]Removed the protruding cliff in the lower right corner.
[*]Straighten cliffs shadows.
[/list]
Minecart is working, rocks spawn everywhere where there is a free space. For machines or minecart access create your own floor/path to prevent rocks spawning.

"[i]What have you done! Map is too empty! You removed all the pretty details![/i]" - I know, main purpose of this mod is to allow players to decorate their buildable spaces as they want whether they use furniture or machines. (FACTORY MUST GROW... I mean sorry, wrong game...)

[i]I'm planning on making this a series of mods. I'm planning to edit the cellar, greenhouse, farm buildings, and other farms. Maybe even the farmhouse interior itself (I took a look and was horrified by what a jigsaw mess it is... So maybe later). Later I will make matching banners and make this site prettier.[/i]

If I overlooked some sprites or you have any ideas let me know (nature cut in half, wrong sprites, etc.).
